notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken Hydras.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken Hydra that does not have Nim Deathmantle attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the Hydra dies, Polukranos and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Polukranos trigger, creating two 3/3 Phyrexian Hydra creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Phyrexian Hydra, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the nontoken Hydra from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Polukranos Reborn // Polukranos, Engine of Ruin
